title: Base fields shared by an rsvp (v2) question item
description: Not used standalone -- extended via allOf by rsvp_form.json's questions[] items. Mirrors the pattern in forms/json_schema/components/questions/base_question.json for the same field set (id/question/isRequired/questionDescription/privacyNote), but is its own file rather than a shared $ref with that one: rsvp's question length bounds (1-1000 chars) differ from the standalone Forms module's (0-200 chars) -- merging the two via allOf would silently tighten one of them to the other's limit.

id.description: Stable client-generated id used to key form responses -- optional for backward compatibility with forms saved before this field existed.
